The HWPX document automation task achieved a perfect success rate using the GPT-5.2 router, validating the current document processing logic.
The execution resulted in a 1.00 verifier reward and 0.80 judge reward with zero exceptions across all trials. Pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' passed in 0.125s, confirming the output meets structural requirements. Reusable success stems from the llmrouter-temp-gpt52 configuration, though the 3m 48s runtime suggests potential latency overhead in the document feedback loop.
